Supreme Court Orders Actor Rajpal Yadav to Deposit Rs 2 Crore

The Supreme Court has ordered actor Rajpal Yadav to deposit Rs 2 crore in a cheque bounce case, warning that his sentence could be increased if he fails to comply. Chief Justice of India (CJI) remarked on the actor's behavior, comparing it to a film title, and noted that the whereabouts of his money were unknown. The court's order comes as Rajpal Yadav sought relief but was denied.
